instruction: Remodel an outpatient clinic from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Remodel the building into a two-storey outpatient clinic and export the final IFC4 model to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. The final IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, eleven IfcSpace objects, twenty-four IfcWall elements, two IfcSlab elements, and one IfcStair. Name the clinic spaces so they include at least four Consultation spaces, two Treatment spaces, two Accessible Toilet spaces, one Waiting space, one Staff space, and one space named exactly Exam Support. The final export should not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The init model is only a starting point and should not be left unchanged. Other room proportions and nonessential metadata may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
